title: WGPU Materials Conformance Harness Follow-on v1
problem: The shared WGPU test readback/render harness now covers path and clip conformance tests, but the material conformance tests still duplicate the same final-render readback helpers. This keeps ADR 0235 / ADR 0242 / ADR 0274 evidence noisier than necessary without adding behavior coverage.

repro.summary: Material-related WGPU conformance tests should render and sample through the shared integration-test support module while preserving existing material assertions.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test materials_conformance --test materials_sampled_conformance -j 1

gates.name: materials-conformance-batch
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-render-wgpu --locked --test materials_conformance --test materials_sampled_conformance -j 1

continue_policy.notes: The named material tests migrated successfully. Future paint/effect/text families should start narrower follow-ons instead of widening this one.
